correctness.rationale: For every reduced planar rooted tree of n≥3 internal vertices the source says standard Loday P_t has affine sum binom(n,2) on n−1 coordinates and complete connected-nest facets sum_{e∈N}x_e≥binom(s+1,2). Uniform c=n/2 gives slack s(n−1−s)/2; intrinsic normal projection has squared norm s(n−1−s)/(n−1). Hence exact distance delta_s=1/2 sqrt((n−1)s(n−1−s)). Squared-distance and minimum-contact claims independently verified exactly for every 3≤n≤199, all s. Analytically s(n−1−s) minimal at s=1 or n−2, and summing singleton normalized clearances for any candidate center bounds r≤1/2 sqrt((n−1)(n−2)); equality forces all center coordinates equal. Connected subsets of every size exist. The finite check supplements the all-tree symbolic proof.
